hooks.text: 每只虫族角色拥有两把武器和四项能力，开局选一武器一能力培养，局内还可能获得随机额外能力
hooks.excerpt: Every bug has 2 weapons and 4 abilities Before a run, choose 1 weapon and 1 ability to level up during the match During gameplay, you may gain one additional random ability , opening new combos
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 武器和能力各有两条协同进化路线，满级后会改变其行为并把普通构筑转成标志流派
hooks.excerpt: Push your gear to its peak and unlock Synergies —powerful transformations that change how your weapons and abilities behave. 2 Synergy paths for every weapon and ability Each path supports a different playstyle Synergies turn strong builds into signature builds
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 无尽模式中击杀提升混沌等级并召出首领，胜利后三选一负面诅咒，再用敌牙向商人购买救命资源
hooks.excerpt: A Chaos Level rises as you kill enemies When it fills, a boss appears Defeat the boss to choose one of 3 Curse Cards Curses are negative modifiers that reshape your run and escalate difficulty A Merchant appears at key milestones Spend Teeth dropped by enemies to buy power-ups, healing, and other run-saving tools
